pr_title: c2c: run TestStreamingAutoReplan on a single multitenant cluster
pr_body:
TestStreamingAutoReplan flakes because the unit test infra cannot handle the resources required to run 2 multinode test clusters. This patch unskips TestStreamingAutoReplan by refactoring it to run on a single multi tenant cluster (i.e. the src and dest tenants run on the same cluster and have the same system tenant), halving the number clusters/servers used by the test.

This patch also modifies the CreateStatteredTable helper to wait until leaseholders have been scattered for the newly scattered table, ensuring the dsp.PartitionSpans() call during ingestion job planning returns multiple source nodes to stream from.

Fixes #106451

Release note: None
